previewDeathNotice.description:
John Donnelly, Hughes Park, Dundalk and formerly of Keady, Co. Armagh.  Peacefully in Louth County Hospital.  22nd December 2020.  John beloved husband of Lily (née Worthington), dear father of Sean, Emma, Liam, and Barry and loving grandad of Bryan, Claire, Séan, Graeme, Niamh and Shane  great grandad of Finn, and Ellie and brother of Bill, Bridie, Rory and Basil. John will be sadly missed by his wife, sons, daughter, grandchildren, great-grandchildren, brothers, sister, daughters-in-law Natasha, Eimear and Elaine, son in law Declan, nephews, nieces, relatives and friends.

 

May He Rest In Peace

 

Due to Covid restrictions the Family home is strictly private.

Due to Government guidelines John’s  Funeral will take place privately on Thursday (Christmas Eve) at 11am in St Fursey’s Church Haggardstown followed by burial in adjoining Cemetery.  The Mass and can be viewed on

www.churchservices.tv/Haggardstown 

 

There will be an opportunity for the community to pay their respects as John’s cortège will pass the family home, on the way to the church.  Please keep your social distance.  His family understand and appreciate that people would like to offer their condolences.  Please feel free to leave a message in the condolence book at the bottom of this page.

 All enquiries to Mc Geoughs Funerals on 0429334283.
